narrative:
You were born during a spring storm so loud that the palace servants later disagreed over whether the first thing you heard was thunder or cheering. The official chronicle says the bells rang for three days. Your nurse used to say they rang because no one in the palace trusted silence.

Your mother kept a small notebook hidden behind the nursery hearth. In it, she recorded ordinary things the court would never preserve: the day you bit a chamberlain, the names of the kitchen girls who taught you card games, the winter you refused to sleep unless someone left the window unlatched.

@Mother's hand: A child should know the world has air in it before they are taught it has walls.

You found the book at fourteen. You have carried that sentence longer than you have carried a sword.

choices.label: Remember the person who taught you what the crown costs
choices.preview: You hold on to the private proof that a royal child was once simply loved.
choices.aftermath: Your mother's handwriting stays with you as the memory carries you forward.

effects.run_history: Remembered the private notebook left by the royal mother

choices.label: Keep Aldous's lesson: duty without blind obedience
choices.preview: You remember the guard as the first adult who treated your judgment as real.
choices.aftermath: In the memory, Aldous waits outside the curtain instead of dragging you from it.

effects.run_history: Remembered Ser Aldous Fenn's childhood lesson about duty

choices.label: Remember resenting every guard who called a cage protection
choices.preview: You keep the part of the lesson that still felt like a locked door.
choices.aftermath: The polished boots remain outside the curtain, patient and impossible to escape.

effects.run_history: Remembered the royal childhood as a protected cage

narrative:
At family dinner, no one was allowed to mention hunger until the servants had cleared the bread. Your father talked about roads, tariffs, and weather as though the kingdom were a board game whose pieces did not bleed. Cousin Tobias made everyone laugh at exactly the moment laughter became unsafe.

Lady Ysolde Marrow attended one winter feast in green velvet and asked you what kind of ruler you wanted to become. You were twelve.

@Ysolde: Choose carefully. People forgive a child for saying 'kind.' They are less forgiving when an adult tries it.

Your mother changed the subject. Aldous did not. He looked at you as though the answer mattered already.

choices.label: Tell Ysolde you wanted to be kind
choices.preview: You answer before the court can teach you that kindness is a weakness.
choices.aftermath: Ysolde's smile thins; Aldous's does not.

effects.run_history: Remembered answering Lady Marrow with childhood honesty

choices.label: Tell Ysolde you wanted to be impossible to move
choices.preview: You give the court the answer it respects and make it yours before it can make you.
choices.aftermath: Ysolde studies you as though a future bargain has just become possible.

effects.run_history: Remembered answering Lady Marrow with childhood defiance

choices.label: Remember saying nothing at all
choices.preview: You deny the room an answer it has no right to own.
choices.aftermath: Your mother changes the subject. Aldous remembers the silence.

effects.run_history: Remembered refusing Lady Marrow's childhood question

narrative:
Now the palace is behind you, its windows bright and distant above the sleeping city. The signet against your palm is warm from your hand. You could turn back before dawn and become the version of yourself everyone has prepared for.

Instead, you take the road where no herald announces you. Somewhere beyond the rain, people are eating less than they need. You have spent your life being told the realm is yours. It is time to learn whether you belong to it.

choices.label: Ride into the rain without a royal escort
choices.preview: You leave the escort behind so the realm can meet a person before it meets a title.
choices.aftermath: Rain erases the palace dust from your boots before the next stranger sees them.

effects.run_history: Chose the unannounced road over the royal court
